system.description:
Water Release: Blessing of Poseidon · cast at A-Rank to S-Rank · no type

Swim speed 60 ft, water breathing, tremorsense 60 ft.

Creatures you deal cold damage to become Shaken until the start of your next turn.

Underwater: no disadvantage on attacks and full range.

Atlantean Trident in place of a weapon attack: melee 3d8 or ranged 2d8 + Ninjutsu modifier cold.

The Trident has +1 critical threat range; against a creature with 2+ ranks of Chilled, its ranks can become Shaken (an Elemental condition).

rules.text: You have a 60-foot swim speed, breathe underwater and have 60 feet of tremorsense.
Creatures you deal cold damage to become Shaken until the beginning of your next turn.
Attacks made underwater aren't at disadvantage and keep their full range.
Atlantean Trident (in place of a weapon attack): melee Ninjutsu attack, reach 5 ft, 3d8 + Ninjutsu modifier cold; ranged, 60 ft, 2d8 + Ninjutsu modifier cold.
Atlantean Trident: +1 critical threat range; cold damage to a creature with 2 or more ranks of Chilled can change them to as many ranks of Shaken (an Elemental condition).
